# Jiuzhou — Motif Language (frozen)

```text
motif_set_id:       jiuzhou.motif-language.v1
frozen:             2026-08-12
applies_to:         golden-jiuzhou
```

## 5 abstract components (frozen)

These are **abstract visual primitives**, not literal peacock
imagery. The evaluator looks for the presence of the components
in the **abstract** form, not the literal peacock reference.

```text
motif-1:  羽眼椭圆   (peacock-feather-eye oval)
          abstract:        an oval or eye-shaped anchor at the focal
                           point of the packaging; never the literal
                           feather-eye pattern.
          where used:      brand mark area; accent panel center.

motif-2:  九瓣放射   (nine-petal radial)
          abstract:        a 9-fold radial structure (3 rings × 3
                           axes); subtle, may be a faint background
                           pattern.
          where used:      lid interior (PKG-GIFT-OPEN), wide
                           negative-space panels.

motif-3:  羽毛流线   (feather streamline)
          abstract:        flowing streamlines derived from feather
                           barbs; the flow has direction, not the
                           feather.
          where used:      base color modulation; subtle base
                           color shift along the streamline.

motif-4:  局部虹彩   (localized iridescence)
          abstract:        a small area of hue rotation (蓝紫
                           shifting to 矿物紫 to 暖灰); a
                           micro-accent.
          where used:      brand mark reflection; "Accent" role
                           per color baseline.

motif-5:  抽象 biological rhythm  (abstract organic rhythm)
          abstract:        irregular organic rhythm in the
                           material rendering; not a literal
                           biological pattern.
          where used:      substrate texture (Material Quality
                           axis); surface micro-rhythm.
```

## Forbidden (re-asserted)

- 大面积浓紫 (large-area saturated purple) — not a component; an explicit fail
- 大面积写实羽毛 (large-area realistic feather) — not a component; an explicit fail
- 夜店式虹彩 (club iridescence) — not a component; an explicit fail

These three are listed in `forbidden-motifs.md`.
